stories.title: New plan sets out scale of football facility shortfall in Flintshire with ten sites identified for investment
stories.summary: Flintshire has half the number of full-size 3G football pitches it needs for its current player base, according to a new plan that identifies three priority sites for new pitches at Deeside Leisure Centre, Hawarden High School and St David’s High School in Saltney. stories.title: Borderlands line passengers could be overpaying at station terminals, Flintshire councillor warns
stories.summary: A motion going before Flintshire County Council this week calls for a public warning over contactless payment terminals at Borderlands line train stations, after warning that some passengers are being charged more than they need to pay. stories.title: Survey shows 75% of Wrexham University graduates enter high-skilled employment
stories.summary: Three in four Wrexham University graduates are now in high-skilled employment, according to the latest UK Graduate Outcomes Survey. The study, run by HESA (Higher Education Statistics Agency), gathered results from 353,755 people across the UK 15 months following their graduation. stories.title: Heat pump grant for Welsh households on heating oil rises to £9,000 from July
stories.summary: Rural households in Wales on heating oil will be able to claim a £9,000 grant to switch to a heat pump from 21 July, after the UK Government increased the available funding by £1,500.
